source_label: September 2026 municipal and operator course additions
policy: Course facts are supported by operator or public-agency pages; location points use official facility maps or Census address geocoding. Indexed-only retrieval and access restrictions are disclosed. No listing guarantees same-day opening.

records.name: Bretton Woods Disc Golf
records.availability_type: Summer and fall resort activity; confirm dates, weather and booking with the operator
records.access: Public resort activity. Published activity hours are 10 a.m.–3:30 p.m. during the operating season.
records.cost_note: Confirm the current activity price with the resort
records.source_observation: The operator describes an 18-hole course at the ski-area base and a seasonal booking schedule. Its page gives differing late-May/June season starts; exact opening dates are not inferred. The owner-published coordinate identifies the ski-area facility, not a verified first tee.

records.name: The Pines at Wheelock Disc Golf Course
records.availability_type: Municipal park course; check park notices and posted access hours
records.access: Public beginner course in Wheelock Park. The facility listing gives daily availability of 8 a.m.–8 p.m.
records.cost_note: The city does not publish a separate course price on the reviewed page
records.source_observation: The municipal facility page confirms a nine-hole beginner course at Wheelock Park and the Park Avenue address. Parking and bathrooms are listed. A separate disc-golf fee or seasonal schedule is not established.

location_source.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
location_source.note: Address-range geocode of the official facility address; not a surveyed entrance or first tee.

records.name: Awasiwi Woods Disc Golf Course
records.availability_type: Dawn–dusk, except sanctioned glow play; school-hour parking restrictions apply
records.access: During school hours park at 375 Hinesburg Road and walk the Awasiwi Trail. School parking is available after school, on weekends and holidays. No alcohol, smoking or vaping.
records.cost_note: No course price is stated on the reviewed city page
records.source_observation: The city confirms nine baskets behind Munsen Field, with two 18-tee layouts, and gives school-hour parking rules. Nine baskets must not be represented as 18 distinct baskets. The map pin is for the designated parking address, not the course center or first tee.

location_source.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
location_source.note: Planning pin for the official school-hours parking address only; walk the Awasiwi Trail to the course.

records.name: Hard’ack Disc Golf
records.availability_type: Public recreation area; gate hours vary with weather and programming
records.access: Open to public play under municipal recreation rules. The property gate may close as early as 5 p.m.; confirm access before visiting.
records.cost_note: No set property-use fee; donations are requested by the operator
records.source_observation: The municipal recreation page confirms an 18-hole course available to the public and a donation-supported property-use policy. The municipal facility directory gives 179 Congress Street. Ski-hill schedules and lodge hours are not treated as disc-golf operating hours.

location_source.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
location_source.note: Address-range geocode of the municipal recreation facility; not a surveyed course entrance.

records.name: Buffumville Lake Disc Golf Course
records.availability_type: Year-round federal recreation property; check closures and conditions
records.access: Free dam-side course beginning near the small Old Oxford Road parking lot. Organized events require a special-use permit.
records.cost_note: Free disc golf; the separate Buffumville Park vehicle charge does not describe this course
records.source_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers — Buffumville Lake
records.source_observation: The official project page identifies an 18-hole free disc golf course beside the dam and the project address. This review used recently indexed official-page content because direct retrieval returned 403. The separate park's seasonal hours and vehicle charge are not assigned to the course.

location_source.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
location_source.note: Address-range geocode of the federal facility address; approximate planning location, not first tee.

records.name: Tully Lake Disc Golf Course
records.availability_type: Year-round when conditions allow; flood-storage closures may apply
records.access: Public course on the lake's south side. Recreation facilities have seasonal limits; the upper gate provides winter access. Keep pets leashed and check federal closure notices.
records.cost_note: Free recreation area; no separate course charge is stated
records.source_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers — Tully Lake
records.source_observation: The federal project page and recreation guide identify an 18-hole disc golf course, the Royalston facility address and year-round access when conditions allow. Review relied on indexed official content and the federal guide; direct page retrieval returned 403. This is not a same-day conditions report.

location_source.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
location_source.note: Address-range geocode of the project facility address; not a verified parking or first-tee location.

records.name: Crane Hill Disc Golf Course
records.availability_type: Year-round sunrise–sunset; check town closure notices
records.access: Public course for residents and nonresidents; no tee time required. Yield to trail users. No disc rentals, alcohol or toilet facilities; carry out trash.
records.cost_note: Free public course according to the town
records.source_observation: The town's course page gives 139V Crane Hill Road, free public access, year-round sunrise-to-sunset hours and course rules. Its companion Crane Hill Trail page confirms the 18-hole course and cautions that the trail crosses or skirts fairways.

location_source.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
location_source.note: Address-range geocode retaining the town-published 139V address; not a surveyed course entrance.

records.name: Orenaug Park Disc Golf Course
records.availability_type: Municipal park listing reports access available; confirm current notices before travel
records.access: Town park with trail access from Park Road and behind the town library. Course-specific hours and tee-time requirements are not stated.
records.cost_note: No course price is stated on the reviewed town page
records.source_observation: The town recreation page lists an 18-hole disc golf course and Park Road location with an Open facility status. It does not establish same-day conditions, prices or daily hours. The approximate map pin uses the destination endpoint of the directions map embedded by the town, not its viewport center.

records.name: North Quarter Park Disc Golf Course
records.availability_type: Municipal multiuse park; confirm posted access rules and closures
records.access: Nine-hole course at the corner of Main Street and Middlesex Avenue. Yield to all park users and never throw while anyone is within range.
records.cost_note: No course price is stated on the reviewed town page
records.source_observation: The town parks listing identifies a nine-hole course at North Quarter Park. Its linked official disc-golf instructions require yielding to park users. Review used indexed town content; a newer document endpoint could not be retrieved. No course hours or residency restrictions are inferred.

location_source.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
location_source.note: Intersection beside the park matching the town location description; not the park center or first tee.
